nodes.name: Mare Survey
nodes.description: Mark the crater rims, glass fields, and landing scars before the warm-grey dust hides the route.

nodes.name: Gravity Tables
nodes.description: Write each claim's pull beside the arcs, strides, and loose cargo it changes.

nodes.name: Atmosphere Dials
nodes.description: Give every dome, suit, and airless yard one counted breath the town can read.
nodes.effect: Banks the per-tile atmosphere-parameter and suit-air family.

nodes.name: Lunar-Day Ledger
nodes.description: Count fourteen light watches and fourteen dark ones before the batteries promise too much.
nodes.effect: Banks the lunar day-and-brown-out ledger family.

nodes.name: Lava-Tube Charts
nodes.description: Prove one seeded route through the dark before a suit crew carries the claim below.
nodes.effect: Banks the connected lunar-tube interior family.

nodes.name: Vacuum Lenses
nodes.description: Carry a warm strike through empty air where no report or concussion can follow.

nodes.name: Lens Turret
nodes.description: Set a tracking silver lens on the old beam-relay footing without moving the tripod.

nodes.name: Breach Seals
nodes.description: Carry numbered seals for the wall that has become the town's breath.
nodes.effect: Banks the dome breach-and-seal defense family.

nodes.name: Magnet Grapple
nodes.description: Yank two loose machines into one silent collision and let low gravity finish the joke.
nodes.effect: Banks the Magnet Grapple arsenal family.

nodes.name: Claw Component Science
nodes.description: A future Claw medal will release the crown, winch, and anchor-foot diagrams.
nodes.effect: Banks the Salvage King's Claw science behind the reserved salvageKingsClawComponentsCaptured medal flag.

nodes.name: Regolith Assay
nodes.description: Grade warm-grey dust, crater glass, and He-3 flecks with the old pan-house rules.

nodes.name: Dome Panels
nodes.description: Fit timber-brass ribs and clear cells so every crack has a named place to mend.
nodes.effect: Banks the staged dome-panel fabrication family.

nodes.name: Airlock Receipts
nodes.description: Tie every crossing to a suit seal, an air count, and the gate that let it through.

nodes.name: Mass-Driver Windows
nodes.description: Give each rail-thrown cargo load a launch mark and an honest arrival window.

nodes.name: Riverward Manifest
nodes.description: Pack air, seed, tools, and the town's promise for the red field beyond the Moon.
nodes.effect: Banks the Colony Seed manifest family for the Riverward.
